svg.text: MOZA MTQ Throttle Panel - Button Reference (js2)
throttle 1-65 + axes · buttons 44-48 are absent on the device

Throttle forward = axis RY; reverse = MHG stick press 29, held. The lever travel behind the idle detent (axis RZ) is unbound. FLAPS & Speedbrake levers drive analog axes (Slider / Dial) in Mining / Salvage modes; detent buttons 31-43 are unbound. WPN-hat shield faces act only on S3 Quadrant shields (trial).
